Mira (Finance): Quick note: short rolling spend guidance and a temporary vendor approval cadence change starting next week. TL;DR below.

Owen (Eng): TL;DR please — we've got a vendor quote to lock.

Mira (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Purchase freeze windows removed but approvals tightened for non-ops spend > $3k. 2) Fast-path for customer-impacting infra up to $7k (use 'ops-fast' tag). 3) Vendor approvals for new software now require product owner sign-off + security ok. 4) Small vendor onboarding (one-off consultants < $2k) now uses expedited onboarding form.

Sal (Procurement): Quick flow: submit standard request and pick 'expedite' if ops-impacting; tag region and project. Procurement triage within 4 business hours; Finance auto-approve ops-fast <= $7k. >$7k goes to Director.

Priya (Finance Partner): Note: product owner sign-off must be a one-line approval in the request. Security must mark 'security-reviewed' in the vendor packet. Missing either will delay approval.

budget-bot: New request #6112 created by owen.eng. Status: pending procurement triage.

Owen (Eng): Uploaded the quote and a short PO justification. Marked as ops-fast.

Mira (Finance): Operational: we'll post a single-page checklist and hold two office hours next week (Mon & Wed 9:30am PT). If this affects customer availability, DM me and tag 'ops-fast' on the form.

Sal (Procurement): Internal note: route expedited small-vendor onboardings to the purchasing queue using template 'vendor-lite'.

Owen (Eng): Thanks — saves us a day on the quote.

Mira (Finance): Final note: temporary rules reviewed at quarter end. We'll tighten or relax based on volume and risk. Posting link to intranet now.
